set_aside.subject: cause and owner of a resubmitted accepted confirmation's refusal
set_aside.text: “A confirmation refused because the closure exists — made by any import accepted before it, of another session or of this one” conflicts with “a resubmission of the very confirmation that was accepted is refused at stage (1), its value used up.”
set_aside.question: Does resubmitting the confirmation that accepted the import fail at stage (1) because `owner_sessions` no longer holds that confirmation, or does it reach `migration_import` and fail because the closure exists?
options: `owner_sessions` refuses at stage (1) because the confirmation value was already consumed
set_aside.default_guess: Refuse at stage (1) through `owner_sessions`, because A13’s check order and one-time confirmation rule precede all import checks.

witness.initial: An owner session successfully confirmed the import; its confirmation value was consumed, the migration closure now exists, and the browser still holds the submitted form.
events: The owner resubmits that same confirmation form with the valid session, CSRF value and previously consumed confirmation value.
outcomes: `owner_sessions` refuses at stage (1) because there is no matching pending confirmation; `migration_import` is never reached.
The request reaches the closure check and `migration_import` refuses it because the migration closure exists.
witness.observer: The owner sees which refusal is returned once State 5 defines the failure presentation, and module-level tests see which module produces it.
